name: Entry time of day for short swing trades
verdict: For 1-5 day longs in high-beta tech (2021-26), buying at 9:35, noon or 15:00 makes no reliable difference (15:00 minus 9:35: -10 bp, +0.5 bp by half). Buying before the close beat waiting for the next open only in 2024+ (+21 bp, t 3.0). 15:00 entries are fine.
